answers.workaround: Technically yes. The platform can be identified with [`OS.get_name( )`](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_os.html#class-os-method-get-name) then, on those platforms that don't provide a unique index, the above proposed approach could be implemented.
